terms.grammar: exclamation; dē + ablative for the person or thing it is about
terms.register: vōx sermōnis cotīdiānī: Catull.; Cic. in epistulīs
evidence: Cic. Att. 15.1.1: ō factum male dē Alexiōne! (Lewis & Short s.v. malus)
terms.comment: Literally “badly done!”, of what fortune has done; the opposite of ō factum bene!.

evidence: Cic. Att. 12.11: male dē Sejō, on the death of a friend
terms.comment: The same exclamation without factum, as Cicero writes it to Atticus.

phrases.latin: ō factum male! ō miselle passer!
phrases.english: oh, what a shame! poor little sparrow!

sources: Lewis & Short: malus
